30% off + an extra 20% off = 50% off? 🤔 Not quite.

1. Open calc.315tools.com and tap Discount
2. Type the original price ($80)
3. Add the discount (30%) and the extra discount (20%)

It's really 44% off: the sale price is $44.80, not $40. 💸
